skill_name: Create a market analysis for a startup company in the digital marketing space.
workflow:
Spotty is a startup company in the digital marketing space. We have analyzed the current market to provide a competitive analysis for our company. We have identified three main competitors and analyzed the strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats of each. 

Our main competitors include Facebook Ads, Google Ads, and Bing Ads. Facebook Ads has the most reach, Google Ads has the most precise targeting and user segmentation capabilities, and Bing Ads is cheaper but has lower user engagement
